caption:
Edited a post and lost the good version? 🛟

1. Open the post in the editor
2. In the settings panel, find Revisions
3. Pick an older version and restore it

WordPress saves earlier versions automatically.

scenes.text: Messed up a post and can't undo it?
scenes.say: Messed up a post and can't undo it? WordPress kept a copy.

scenes.label: WordPress keeps earlier versions of your posts
scenes.say: Good news. WordPress automatically keeps earlier versions of your posts.

scenes.title: Restore an old version
items: Open the post in the editor
scenes.say: Three steps. Open the post in the editor. Find Revisions in the settings panel. Pick an older version and restore it.

scenes.title: Compare first
scenes.body: Check what changed between versions, then restore.
scenes.say: Tip. Compare the versions first, then restore the one you want.
Without revisions, you retype it all from memory. With revisions, you're back in a few clicks.
